judgment.rationale: The report identifies a per-user Microsoft Store installation but does not say where PowerToys cannot be found, what uninstall path was attempted, or what happened. Those details are needed to distinguish a Store listing/search issue from a Windows package-removal failure.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys 0.101.2362, a per-user installation, and Microsoft Store as the installation method.
The title/body say the app is not visible in the Store and cannot be deleted, but provide no uninstall steps or error.
There are no comments, screenshots, or installer logs.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact app-listing location and uninstall attempt/error so the failure can be routed to the correct owner.

fix_assessment.rationale: The available report is insufficiently scoped to determine whether a PowerToys code change is applicable; the relevant Store, package-registration, or uninstall path is not yet identified.

known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.101.2362, Microsoft Store, and per-user install scope.
The issue body contains no reproduction steps, error text, or comment discussion.
inferences: The report may concern Store search/library visibility, Windows installed-app registration, or an uninstall failure; the current text does not distinguish these cases.
issue_context.analysis: The exact surface and uninstall result determine whether this belongs to Store discovery, Windows package registration, or PowerToys removal. Ask only for the UI location and exact attempt/error; do not ask for generic logs before identifying the failing path.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body and discussion; no attachment, reproduction sequence, or duplicate/fix link is present.
The issue says Microsoft Store and per-user, but does not state whether the app is absent from Settings > Installed apps, the Start menu, or the Store Library, or what operation fails.

information_gaps.information: Where the PowerToys entry is missing and what exact uninstall action and result occur
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes a Store visibility issue from a Windows installed-app/package-removal failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the exact surface (Microsoft Store search or Library, Start, or Settings > Apps > Installed apps), the uninstall steps attempted, and any visible error text.

comment.body:
Thanks for listing the PowerToys version, Microsoft Store installation method, and per-user scope. I can't tell from the report whether PowerToys is missing from the Store listing or whether Windows cannot remove an installed package.

Please identify where you looked (Microsoft Store search or Library, Start, or Settings > Apps > Installed apps), then describe the exact uninstall steps you tried and any error text or result. This will distinguish a Store visibility problem from a Windows package-registration or uninstall failure and determine which component can investigate it.

status.label: Confirm uninstall failure
